bugs.name: People search does not escape LIKE wildcards: '%' and '_' match every person
bugs.summary: Typing % lists all 3 people (Harbor Admin, Jordan Ellis, Maya Chen) and says '3 people found'; a single _ does the same. The backend call /api/user?query=%25 passes the text unescaped, so % and _ act as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal characters in the filter. (on /admin/people)
bugs.expected: A search for % (a character that does not occur in any name or email) finds no people and shows the 'No results found' empty state, as typing 'zzz' already does.
bugs.actual: Typing % lists all 3 people (Harbor Admin, Jordan Ellis, Maya Chen) and says '3 people found'; a single _ does the same. The backend call /api/user?query=%25 passes the text unescaped, so % and _ act as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal characters in the filter.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai and open /admin/people.
Click the 'Find someone' search box.
Type a single % character.
Wait for the list to update and read the rows and the footer count.
Also try a single _ character.

bugs.name: Database caching form: server rejection of an over-large Minimum query duration shows only 'Failed', no message
bugs.summary: The value is accepted into the field and \"Save changes\" stays enabled, but PUT /api/cache answers 400 and the only feedback is the button label changing to \"Failed\" (grey). Nothing says what is wrong, what the maximum allowed value is, or that the old value is still in force; the form stays dirty and the console logs {status: 400}. (on /admin/performance/databases)
bugs.expected: The page should explain the rejection — for example a message next to \"Minimum query duration\" saying the value is too large, and the allowed maximum — or refuse the value while typing, so the person knows what to correct and that nothing was saved.
bugs.actual: The value is accepted into the field and \"Save changes\" stays enabled, but PUT /api/cache answers 400 and the only feedback is the button label changing to \"Failed\" (grey). Nothing says what is wrong, what the maximum allowed value is, or that the old value is still in force; the form stays dirty and the console logs {status: 400}.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /admin/performance/databases (Admin > Performance > Database caching).
Select the "Adaptive" cache invalidation policy.
Type 999999999999999999999 into "Minimum query duration".
Click "Save changes" and read the button and the page.

bugs.name: Adding a group membership that already exists returns 500 and the People page swallows the error
bugs.summary: The click sends POST /api/permissions/membership, which answers 500; the console logs the failed request plus an uncaught page error, the tick never appears next to "Administrators", the row keeps reading "Default", and nothing on the page tells the person anything went wrong — the dropdown just stays as it was. (on /admin/people)
bugs.expected: Adding a group the person already has either does nothing visible (the app notices the membership exists and shows it ticked, or refreshes the row) or fails with a clear message next to the action; in no case does the request crash with a 500 that is swallowed without a word.
bugs.actual: The click sends POST /api/permissions/membership, which answers 500; the console logs the failed request plus an uncaught page error, the tick never appears next to "Administrators", the row keeps reading "Default", and nothing on the page tells the person anything went wrong — the dropdown just stays as it was.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, open /admin/people, and open a second browser tab on /admin/people as well.

In the first tab, click the Groups cell of the "Jordan Ellis / jordan@example.test" row and click "Administrators" in the dropdown: the membership is saved (POST /api/permissions/membership → 200) and the row starts reading "Admin".
Now switch to the second tab, which was loaded before that change and still shows "Default" for Jordan Ellis.
In the second tab click the Groups cell of the Jordan Ellis row (the dropdown shows only "All Users" ticked, "Administrators" unticked, because the tab is stale) and click "Administrators".
Watch the page and the network: POST /api/permissions/membership → 500, no tick appears, the row still says "Default", no error is shown.

bugs.name: Unresolvable SSH tunnel host shows a raw Java exception string in the database form error
bugs.summary: The red error panel under the form shows the raw internal exception instead of a readable reason: «Metabase tried, but couldn't connect / DefaultConnectFuture[agent11@ssh.example.com/<unresolved>:22]: Failed (UnresolvedAddressException) to execute: null». Below it only two irrelevant hints follow ("Try using a secure connection (SSL)", "Check Metabase user permissions"). Nothing tells the admin that the SSH tunnel host could not be resolved. With a resolvable SSH host (localhost) the same failure is worded properly ("Hmm, we couldn't connect to the database / Make sure your Host and Port settings are correct"), so only the unresolvable-host path leaks the exception. (on /admin/databases/create)
bugs.expected: A readable message such as "Could not resolve the SSH tunnel host ssh.example.com", without a raw Java/Netty exception or a stray "null"
bugs.actual: The red error panel under the form shows the raw internal exception instead of a readable reason: «Metabase tried, but couldn't connect / DefaultConnectFuture[agent11@ssh.example.com/<unresolved>:22]: Failed (UnresolvedAddressException) to execute: null». Below it only two irrelevant hints follow ("Try using a secure connection (SSL)", "Check Metabase user permissions"). Nothing tells the admin that the SSH tunnel host could not be resolved. With a resolvable SSH host (localhost) the same failure is worded properly ("Hmm, we couldn't connect to the database / Make sure your Host and Port settings are correct"), so only the unresolvable-host path leaks the exception.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5501-ifu9zeza11kw2jt1zrm8o.e2b.app/admin/databases, then click 'Add database' (form opens with Database type = PostgreSQL)
In 'Connection string (optional)' type postgresql://agent11:secret@db.example.com:5432/agent11db and press Tab, so Display name, Host, Port, Database name, Username and Password are pre-filled
Switch 'Use an SSH-tunnel' on
Fill 'SSH tunnel host' with ssh.example.com, 'SSH tunnel username' with agent11 and 'SSH private key' with any text between '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' and '-----END PRIVATE KEY-----'
Click 'Save' and read the error panel at the bottom of the form
